message.content: {"reasoning":"The defendant was a business employee who abused his position to issue false delivery orders, used the company seal without authorization, and took company goods to sell for personal gain. This constitutes abuse of a position of trust to appropriate the property of the unit, which is defined as 职务侵占 under Chinese criminal law. No other distinct crimes such as fraud or theft apply given the nature of the act.", "final_answer":"[罪名]职务侵占<eoa>"}
message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: employee (business staff) uses position to issue false delivery orders, uses company seal, takes goods, sells low, uses proceeds to repay personal debt, rest wasted. The company got money back later. This is embezzlement? In Chinese criminal law, "职务侵占" (embezzlement by a person in a position of trust) is when a person in a position of trust (e.g., staff) appropriates property of the unit. The facts: He used his position to issue false delivery orders, used company seal, took goods, sold them. That's "职务侵占" (embezzlement). Also possibly "挪用公款"? But it's not public funds, it's private company. So "职务侵占" is correct. Also maybe "诈骗"? No, he didn't deceive a third party; he just sold goods. Could be "盗窃"? He took goods without permission, but he used his position and seal, so it's not simple theft but "职务侵占". The examples: earlier example with Zhang modifying checks etc was "职务侵占". So answer: [罪名]职务侵占<eoa>
